user.title: Connect to Vikunja
user.description: Create an API token in Vikunja under Settings → API Tokens. It needs these permissions: Projects (read all), Tasks (read all, read one, create, update, delete), Labels (read all), Tasks Labels (bulk), Tasks Comments (create).

data_description.url: Vikunja address as seen from Home Assistant, e.g. http://localhost:3456.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Vikunja
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} stopped working or is missing a permission. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Vikunja. Check the URL.
error.invalid_auth: Vikunja rejected the API token, or it lacks the permissions listed above.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that URL, but it doesn't look like the Vikunja API.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Vikunja account is already configured.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a task in the project behind a Vikunja to-do list, with extras the to-do services can't set. Returns the new task.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: Names of existing Vikunja labels to add.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Returns tasks from all projects matching a Vikunja filter query.

config_entry_id.name: Vikunja account
config_entry_id.description: Which Vikunja account to query. Defaults to the first one.

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: Vikunja filter, see vikunja.io/docs/filters. E.g. done = false && priority >= 3.

search.name: Search
search.description: Only tasks whose text contains this.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a task.

config_entry_id.name: Vikunja account
config_entry_id.description: Which Vikunja account to use. Defaults to the first one.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: Numeric task id, as in the task's URL.
